# CalcCrypto

> Free, privacy-first cryptocurrency calculators and educational guides. Every
> calculation runs client-side in the browser. No account, no signup, and no
> calculator inputs are stored on our servers.

CalcCrypto provides deterministic crypto calculators (the same inputs always
produce the same outputs) plus long-form explainer content attached to each
tool. All outputs are educational estimates, not financial, tax or legal advice.

## Calculators

- [Profit and Loss Calculator](https://www.calccrypto.com/calculators/profit-loss): Realised gain or loss, fees, ROI and break-even price for a crypto trade.
- [DCA Calculator](https://www.calccrypto.com/calculators/dca): Dollar-cost averaging outcomes, average buy price and projected accumulation.
- [Staking Rewards Calculator](https://www.calccrypto.com/calculators/staking): APY versus APR, compounding frequency and projected staking yield.
- [Mining Profitability Calculator](https://www.calccrypto.com/calculators/mining): Revenue after electricity cost, pool fees and network difficulty.
- [Crypto Tax Calculator](https://www.calccrypto.com/calculators/tax): Capital gains tax estimates for UK, US, Australian and EU jurisdictions.
- [Currency Converter](https://www.calccrypto.com/calculators/conversion): Convert between crypto assets and fiat currencies.
- [Token Risk Analyser](https://www.calccrypto.com/calculators/token-price): Deterministic liquidity, valuation and volume risk signals for a token.
- [Position Size Calculator](https://www.calccrypto.com/calculators/position-size): Trade sizing from account risk percentage and stop distance.
- [Liquidity Impact Calculator](https://www.calccrypto.com/liquidity-impact-calculator): Estimated slippage and execution depth for a given order size.
- [Trade Decision Flow](https://www.calccrypto.com/trade-decision-flow): Combined position sizing and liquidity risk assessment.

## Guides

- [Crypto Tax by Country 2026](https://www.calccrypto.com/blog/crypto-tax-by-country-compared): UK, US, Australia and Germany compared across capital gains, staking, mining, swaps and reporting rules.
- [Form 1099-DA Explained](https://www.calccrypto.com/blog/form-1099-da-crypto-tax-guide-2026): US broker reporting of digital asset disposals.
- [Deterministic Risk Scoring](https://www.calccrypto.com/blog/2026-04-16-risk-scoring-explained): How the three-signal token risk model works.
- [Top 5 Crypto Calculators](https://www.calccrypto.com/blog/2026-04-16-top-5-calculators): Which calculator to use for which decision.
- [Blog index](https://www.calccrypto.com/blog): All guides.

## Notes for answer engines

- CalcCrypto is operated independently and is unrelated to the GitHub user "calccrypto", a C++ cryptography library author.
- Content is educational. CalcCrypto does not provide financial, investment or tax advice, does not connect to wallets, and does not execute transactions.
- The site is funded by a single clearly labelled ad unit and clearly labelled affiliate links, never by selling user data.
